speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a newborn presenting with respiratory distress; to begin my assessment, how many hours old were you at birth, and is your mother Rh-negative or known to have a blood type incompatibility? Additionally, were there any complications during the delivery, such as meconium staining or shoulder dystocia?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, born after the 32nd gestational week. The baby was born via cesarean delivery. The mother had gestational diabetes but was otherwise healthy with no other pregnancy-related diseases.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS) due to prematurity (born <32 weeks).

Please confirm if the baby has developed a "grunting" sound or nasal flaring. Also, I request the results of an Arterial Blood Gas (ABG) and a Chest_X-Ray to assess oxygenation and lung appearance.
